name: task card (manifest card)
what: One task on the day board: title link, status dot, the step bar, figures and a reply box.
render: import { manifest_card } from '/framework/ext/AITask/card.js'; manifest_card({ title: 'Demo task', url: '/framework/ai/', name: 'demo', brief: 'A task that has not started.', m: null });
notes: Three-column grid capped at 60em; title ::after spreads the link over the whole card.

name: highlight card
what: A small card a finished task marks as its best result: icon, title link, one line, a log link.
render: import { highlights } from '/framework/ext/AITask/highlights.js'; highlights([{ url: '/framework/ai/2026-09-24/demo/', m: { highlight: { title: 'A demo highlight', line: 'One sentence about it.', url: '/framework/ai/' } } }]);
notes: Sits in an auto grid `.ai-hl-wall`, 20em columns.

name: needs-you strip
what: A box listing every thing only the owner can do, shortest first, with minutes.
render: import { needs_strip } from '/framework/ext/AITask/needs.js'; needs_strip([{ what: 'Log in to the host', minutes: 5, id: 'x', url: '/framework/ai/', label: 'demo' }]);
notes: Draws nothing when empty.

name: ask card
what: A question or report from an agent to the owner: needs line, title, two clamped lines, status chip, links, a screenshot.
notes: Needs a loaded task log (asks(m, base, to_prompt, redraw)); not drawn standalone. Click opens .ai-ask-sheet under it.

name: ask sheet
what: The panel that opens under an ask card with the full question, the weighed options and the task.
notes: Spans the full grid row (.ai-ask-detail grid-column 1 / -1).

name: decision row
what: One decision with an Approve / Improve verdict: a line you click to open the options, the rule and a note box.
padding: hairline top + --gap-35 top pad; no side pad (ai.css:270)
notes: Reuses ui-decision-* classes from the ux tier inside an ai- wrapper. v2.css re-declares the same rules under .v2 (duplicate CSS, also `.ai-group-title`, `.ai-rank-grip`).

name: fold (expando bar)
what: A clickable bar over a hidden body, built only on first open.
render: import { fold } from '/framework/ext/AITask/message.js'; fold('Click to open', () => { p('The hidden body.'); });
notes: Four copies of the same idea: ai-fold, ai2-said/ai2-toc (details), v3-day-row (details), v2-earlier (details).

name: transcript message
what: One agent message or tool result: text, thinking (folded), tool call line, result, image.
render: import { message } from '/framework/ext/AITask/message.js'; message({ type: 'assistant', message: { content: 'Hello from an agent.' } });

name: turn (transcript turn)
what: One prompt-and-answer turn in a replay or live feed, with a meta row.
padding: .5em .75em raw (feed.css:8) but ai.css:395 says gap-50 no pad
notes: Two rules for .ai-turn (ai.css and feed.css) disagree on padding; feed.css wins by load order.

name: owner prompt bubble (ai-you)
what: The owner's own message in a chat replay, a bordered box that lights up when selected.
notes: Three different ways to mark the owner's words.

name: prompt rail row
what: One line in the chat rail: prompt text ellipsised, time on the right.

name: screenshot thumb
what: A 4:3 thumbnail of a screenshot a worker logged, linking to full size, with fallback.
render: import { shot_thumb } from '/framework/ext/AITask/shots.js'; shot_thumb({ path: 'nope.png', label: 'demo shot', width: 800 });
notes: Shows 'no image' off localhost.

name: usage meter
what: A bar gauge for one usage limit with a clock marker and 'on pace for' note.
render: import { usage_rail } from '/framework/ext/AITask/usage.js'; usage_rail({ utilization: { limits: [{ kind: 'session', group: 'session', percent: 40, resets_at: new Date(Date.now() + 3e6).toISOString() }] } });
notes: ai2 redraws the same bar with its own ai2-ov-usage-* classes (overview.js:198): a twin.

name: group heading (ai-group)
what: A small uppercase title with a count above a group of cards.
render: import { div, span } from '/app.js'; div.c('ai-group-title muted', () => { span('Landed'); span.c('ai-count', ' 3'); });
notes: Four heading styles for the same job.

name: timeline day line
what: A rule with a day label in the day timeline.

name: link chip
what: A boxed link to a task or file.
notes: Three link classes, one job.

name: inbox row (rail preview)
what: The two-line preview in the AI 2 rail: title, time, author and last sentence; always the same height.
render: import { row } from '/framework/ai2/card.js'; div.c('ai2-row', () => row({ title: 'Demo card', at: new Date().toISOString(), author: 'owner', text: 'The card says one thing.', said: [], refined: '' }));
notes: The site's main duplication: the same card as task card, inbox row, v3 tile and ask card.

name: inbox full card
what: The whole card on the page: title, flag button, who and time, refined words, chips, your words, sketches, links.
render: import { full } from '/framework/ai2/card.js'; div.c('ai2-full', () => full({ title: 'Demo', at: new Date().toISOString(), author: 'owner', kind: 'prompt', text: 'Say it once.', refined: '', names: ['a-name'], said: ['Hello.'], proposals: [{ title: 'Sketch', shape: ['One idea.'] }], links: [{ url: '/framework/ai2/', label: 'AI 2' }] }, { held(){}, flag(){}, unflag(){} }));
notes: Scrolls itself (overflow-y auto).

name: sub-card table of contents
what: A fold listing every task, proposal and paragraph in a card's log, each a link row.
notes: Needs sub_rows(entries) from inbox.js.

name: flag box
what: One line for typing what is wrong with a card.

name: proposal quote (sketch)
what: The assistant's first sketch, marked by a start border.
notes: Three separate left-border quotes with different colors and paddings.

name: name chip
what: A small pill naming a page or thing the assistant minted.
render: import { div, span } from '/app.js'; div.c('ai2-chips flex wrap gap-25', () => { span.c('ai2-chip', 'a-name'); });

name: overview column
what: One of the AI 2 overview columns (Needs, Reports, Landed, Live): header, count, new-items pill, scrolling rows.
notes: Built by a streaming function; needs a live source, not standalone.

name: overview row
what: One line in an overview column: title link, one clamped line and time.
notes: Third one-line-row style in this realm; a bare div.c built outside its parent has once drawn into the page root (comment at overview.js:82).

name: overview usage bar
what: A labelled usage bar in the overview.
notes: Duplicate of the AITask usage meter.

name: live item
what: A row in the Live card: state, name, one line, clear button.

name: chat line
what: One line of a conversation with a card: who, text, and a reply/update variant.

name: composer
what: The microphone and text box where the owner talks to the assistant.
notes: Needs speech and a servex stream, so not standalone. A twin of v3's composer (ai/v/3/compose.js:37).

name: v3 tile (inbox card)
what: A card in the v3 board: icon and title on one row, one sentence, the author. Big when it needs the owner.
render: import { div, span } from '/app.js'; div.c('card v3-tile v3-tile-big', () => { div.c('v3-tile-head flex v-center gap', () => div.c('v3-tile-title', 'Demo')); div.c('v3-tile-sentence', 'One sentence.'); div.c('v3-tile-foot flex v-center', () => span.c('v3-tile-author', 'mastermind')); });
notes: Only kind here that wears the framework .card; every other one hand-rolls its padding.

name: v3 compact row
what: The ordinary one-line inbox row: icon, bold title, author.
render: import { div, span } from '/app.js'; div.c('v3-tile-compact', () => { div.c('v3-tile-title', 'Compact row'); span.c('v3-tile-author muted', 'you'); });

name: v3 day row
what: A collapsible summary row for one day (or one group) on the v3 board.
notes: A details element wearing a card ground.

name: agents strip chip
what: A chip for one running or idle agent; on = selected.
notes: Reads an agent host stream, not standalone.

name: view button
what: A small toggle button in the v3 toolbar (sort / view).
notes: Three toolbar buttons that do the same thing.

name: axis time item
what: Hour line, collapsed-gap break or card slot on the v3 timeline axis.

name: undo toast
what: A bar with a message and Undo, at the bottom of the board.

name: ask answer buttons
what: The row of option buttons that answers an ask from a v3 card.

name: v3 composer
what: The talk box under the v3 board.
notes: Twin of ai2/compose.js.

name: v2 panel / topic
what: A bordered box with a head and a list of note, agent, need and ask rows.
notes: Own size variable --size; padding is in rem, not the framework's --pad.

name: panel (Panel item)
what: A resizable box that holds content and can split into more panels; the building block of the layout lab.
render: import { panel } from '/framework/ext/Panel/workspace.js'; panel({ text: 'A panel' });
notes: panel() signature is `seed`; check the seed shape in vocab.js before relying on { text }.

name: panel toolbar button
what: A square icon button on a panel's overlay toolbar.
notes: Needs a panel item.

name: panel properties row
what: A labelled knob (range, output) in the properties region.
notes: Needs a focused panel.

name: panel template block
what: A ready-made content block dropped into a panel: stat, clock, rail, contents list, brand.
notes: Draws inside a panel only.

name: workspace
what: Three-region shell: panels, toolbar and viewport list.
notes: A class, not a function; not standalone.

name: doc well (page title block)
what: The title strip at the top of every Doc page.
notes: Doc has no exhibit or callout blocks of its own; those live in ext/demo (part B). It only builds tabs, well and files browser.

name: doc files browser
what: A files panel wrapped in .doc-files with panel-height 42em.
